sentences.text: Present:- Mr. Puneet Kakkar, Advocate for the petitioner.

The present petition has been filed under Section 438 Cr.P.C for grant of pre-arrest bail to the petitioner in FIR No.264 dated 10.9.2020 registered under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC at Police Station, Sector 13-17, Panipat.
By virtue of the order dated 5.7.2022 while granting interim protection, the petitioner was directed to join investigation.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in pursuance to the order dated 5.7.2022 petitioner has joined investigation and fully cooperated and thus, the interim order may kindly be made absolute.
Learned State counsel on instructions from SI Satpal Singh has endorsed the fact that petitioner has joined investigation and submitted that he is no more required for further investigation.
In view of the above, the order dated 5.7.2022 is made absolute subject to compliance of conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C and the petition stands allowed.
 (RAJESH BHARDWAJ)
